name: Bluebeam Revu
purpose: Where the takeoff actually happens. Shawn marks up the plan set in Revu; DEMEX reads the measurement annotations back out of the saved PDF and turns them into priced quantities. This is the single most important integration in the stack.

auth.notes: Revu is a desktop application. Integration is by reading the annotation objects embedded in the saved PDF.

writes: markup legend / colour standard applied by the estimator in Revu

trigger.detail: run tools/takeoff_markup_extract.py on the saved marked-up PDF

known_limits: Colour is the only scope signal in the file - if the estimator deviates from the legend the extraction is wrong. See standards/takeoff/DEMEX_Takeoff_Markup_Standard.md.
Freehand /Ink highlights carry no text, so they extract as an unlabeled count and always need review.
Extracted quantities are gross geometry. Waste, overlap, thickness and access factors are applied by the pricing engine, not the extractor.
